**Dashboard 1 of 4 (Section 12.4).** RED signals (Rate, Errors, Duration) for the gateway's hot path, plus per-upstream-server health.

**Status as of Phase 3 Day 15: real data, sourced from the audit log, not live Prometheus.** Section 12.3 describes real golden-signal metrics (`interpose_tool_calls_total` etc.) -- those still don't exist (no `/metrics` endpoint, no Prometheus deployed). What you're looking at instead is `agg_telemetry_hourly`, produced by `interpose.analytics.aggregate_telemetry` from the audit log's own `status`/`latency_ms` columns -- real request-rate/latency/error data, just sourced from the audit trail rather than a dedicated metrics pipeline. Fixed historical window (2026-07-06 to 2026-08-03) because the data behind it is a one-time synthetic generation (`generate_synthetic_telemetry`, Section 10.6), not a live feed -- adjust the time picker within that range, not to "now".

targets.rawSql:
SELECT hour AS time, outcome AS metric, sum(call_count)::float8 / 3600 AS value
        FROM agg_telemetry_hourly
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(hour)
        GROUP BY hour, outcome
        ORDER BY hour

SELECT hour AS time,
               avg(latency_p50_ms) AS p50,
               avg(latency_p95_ms) AS p95,
               avg(latency_p99_ms) AS p99
        FROM agg_telemetry_hourly
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(hour)
        GROUP BY hour
        ORDER BY hour

SELECT sum(error_count)::float8 / NULLIF(sum(call_count), 0) AS "error_rate"
        FROM agg_telemetry_hourly
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(hour)

SELECT server,
               sum(call_count) AS calls,
               sum(error_count) AS errors,
               round(avg(latency_p95_ms)::numeric, 1) AS p95_latency_ms
        FROM agg_telemetry_hourly
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(hour)
        GROUP BY server
        ORDER BY calls DESC
